avis.titre: Huge Downgrade: Lux Price for Drugstore Quality
avis.texte: This new 3-in-1 version is a completely different (and worse) product. As a long-time, loyal user of the original RetrinAL eye formula, I am incredibly disappointed in this reformulation. Avène is coasting on the high ratings of the old product, but make no mistake this is not the same cream. The Formula: The original had a rich, thick consistency with that signature creamy yellow hue that felt smooth and luxurious. It stayed where you put it. This new "3-in-1" version is runny, thin, and feels like a low-tier drugstore lotion. The Packaging: The downgrade in packaging is the most obvious sign of cost-cutting. It went from a sturdy, slim, high-end pump to flimsy, cheap plastic. For the price Avène charges, I expect a high quality experience, not a bottle with a cheap sticker that feels like it's going to crack in my travel bag. I actually dodged a bullet when my order for the .05 face cream was canceled, because if it's anything like this eye cream, the brand has completely lost its way. New users might not know what they're missing, but if you've used the original RetrinalAL formulations for years, you will immediately notice the lack of quality. I'll be returning this and beginning the hunt for a new brand. Avène, please stop transferring old 5-star reviews to this new formulation; it's misleading to your customers by using washed out reviews.

The Avène RetrinAL EYES Advanced 3-in-1 Eye Cream is a dermatologist-recommended treatment designed to address fine lines, puffiness, and dark circles around the delicate eye area. Its key ingredient, retinaldehyde, is a stabilized form of vitamin A that is more potent than retinol yet gentle enough for sensitive skin. This compound promotes collagen production and accelerates skin cell turnover, aiming to smooth wrinkles and enhance skin firmness. ￼ ￼ The formula also includes hyaluronic acid for hydration and dextran sulfate to reduce puffiness and dark circles. Avène's signature Thermal Spring Water is incorporated to soothe and calm the skin. ￼ ￼ Clinical studies have shown that 72% of users experienced improved skin firmness around the eye contour, and 68% saw a decrease in dark circle intensity after 57 days of use. ￼ While many users appreciate its lightweight, velvety texture and effectiveness, some with extremely sensitive eyes have reported irritation. It's advisable for individuals with known sensitivities to review the ingredient list carefully before use. Overall, the Avène RetrinAL EYES Advanced 3-in-1 Eye Cream is a well-formulated product that combines potent anti-aging ingredients with soothing components, making it a suitable option for those seeking to improve the appearance of the eye area. ￼
